answer: A burst of registrations hence prices itself out, because the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The delta multiplier is published, charged in whisper, and orchard lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 3 for each identity already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. A farm of 1366 identities would post 3314 proofs and burn roughly 3 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
